item.title: China Open Source Daily — 2026-10-16
item.description: Two institutionally dense placements from the 2026-10-15 WeChat input feed, both documenting Chinese open-source institutional objects this series' prior fifty-four briefings have not documented at before: (1) China Academy of Information and Communications Technology's (CAICT, 中国信通院) 2026 OSCAR Open Source Peak Practice Application Call opened 2026-10-12, positioning OSCAR as the annual institutional instrument of CAICT's open-source-and-intelligent-safety department with three participant categories (open-source project / industrial application / enterprise practice) plus five directions plus a screening-defense-announcement cycle (10/26-27 screening, 10-bottom defense, 11-month OSCAR Open Source Industry Conference announcement) plus the first-documented instance in this series of CAICT pairing an open-source-peak-practice recognition call with a research-outcome-inclusion privilege for the Cloud Computing Open Source Industry Association (CCSIOA), and (2) BAAI's 众智FlagOS Community plus Beijing Quantum Information Research Institute plus China Society of Automotive Engineering Embodied-Intelligence Robotics Branch plus Zhongguancun AI Open Source Alliance launch of the 2026 AI Open Compute Conference (AICC) at Zhongguancun National Autonomous Innovation Demonstration Center on 2026-10-17 to 2026-10-18, pairing FlagOS's once-write-many-chip-run positioning with an industrial consortium (Tsmicro 清微智能, Yixing Intelligence 奕行智能, Qingcheng Jizhi 清程极智, plus embodied-intelligence representatives) that jointly institutionalize the chip-system-framework-application open ecosystem — a first-documented instance in this series of BAAI as a state-adjacent research institute plus a quantum-information state-adjacent research institute plus an industry-branch engineering society plus a Zhongguancun open-source alliance co-hosting a joint open-source-compute-institutional-formation layer simultaneously with an industrial-consortium layer.
